intro: Verog's Head is the grisly trophy claimed from Verog the Dervish, a prominent Kolkar centaur leader who oversees forces around the Stagnant Oasis. It is sought by the orc Regthar Deathgate as proof of the chieftain's demise and to demoralize the aggressive Kolkar tribes threatening the Barrens.

p: The Kolkar centaur pose a relentless threat to Horde travelers and supply routes across the northern Barrens. Verog the Dervish, known for his nomadic habits, leaves his command tent at the Stagnant Oasis vulnerable while roaming the arid scrubland. To bring him out into the open, Horde operatives attack his forces around his pavilion until an alarm is raised. Once Verog rushes back to defend his camp, he is slain and decapitated. Delivering his severed head to Regthar Deathgate serves as vital evidence that another dangerous Kolkar chieftain has been dismantled, joining the head of Barak Kodobane on display.
